plugins.name: diffmode-growth-tactics
plugins.description: Free growth-strategy builder for startups that can't outspend their competitors. Point /start at your product URL and Diffmode researches who your buyers are and how your rivals win them, then builds 7-9 unconventional ways to get users — calibrated to your budget, stage, and team. You keep the competitor read, the buyer map, and the acquisition audit as briefs you can reuse. Runs locally into ./<slug>/ in your cwd; no account or API key needed — research runs on the built-in web search, with an opt-in Perplexity MCP path if you'd rather use your own.
